Reports

One report model, bound from your own classes, exported to PDF, Excel and CSV, plus readers for CSV and fixed-length files.

Packages

Package What it does Builds on
Report Core report model infrastructure with document-table hierarchy, reflection-based data binding, PDF abstractions (IPdfExporter, IPdfMerger), and Sheet abstractions for CSV/Excel/fixed-length file reading and exporting (ICsvReader, ICsvExporter, IExcelExporter, IFixedLengthReader) with attribute-based field mapping and custom converters. —
Report.FixedLength Implementation of NuvTools.Report.FixedLength abstractions: reflection-based reader for fixed-length (positional) text files with attribute-based field mapping, custom converters, and trim/optional-field support. Report
Report.Pdf PDF report generation with table rendering, company branding, and document merging using QuestPDF and PDFsharp. Report
Report.Sheet Implementation of NuvTools.Report.Sheet abstractions: Excel export with multi-sheet workbooks and styled formatting using ClosedXML, and CSV export and reading with RFC 4180 support. Report
